instruction: Using only the standalone stem, independently free-generate exactly one most likely condition, exactly two priority nursing actions, and exactly two monitoring or evaluation parameters. Return the required structured JSON and identify the stem evidence and any missing information needed for specificity or uniqueness.
stem: A client at 34 weeks has an antenatal diagnosis of vasa previa. The membranes rupture, followed immediately by painless bright-red vaginal bleeding. The fetal tracing becomes sinusoidal and then shows sustained bradycardia at 70/min. Maternal blood pressure is 122/74 mm Hg, the abdomen is soft, and there is no uterine tenderness. Operative and neonatal teams are present. Complete the bow-tie by choosing the condition, 2 actions, and 2 parameters to monitor.
